chunks: “Amir al-Mu’minin عليه السلام wiped over the two sandals and did not pass beneath the two straps.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.يَسْتَبْطِنِ: to pass underneath or into the inner side

ai.seo_question: How did Amir al-Mu’minin عليه السلام perform wiping in wudu while wearing sandals?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Amir al-Mu’minin عليه السلام in wudu (ablution), specifically how he performed wiping while wearing sandals. It is significant in discussions of ritual purity and the legal details of wiping the feet in Shia fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.86 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"The Commander of the Faithful (as) wiped over his sandals and did not remove the straps”.
